description: Windsurf Cascade hooks for Fabrik enforcement. Schema follows current Cascade docs (object keyed by event; post_* hooks SURFACE output via show_output but cannot block — only pre_* hooks block via exit 2). Commands self-locate the repo root via `git rev-parse` so this file is correct verbatim in any project (synced fleet-wide).

post_cascade_response.command: bash -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && PY=python3; [ -x .venv/bin/python ] && PY=.venv/bin/python; "$PY" scripts/final_gate.py --lean --check'
